Prior to working as a librarian, Sharma **[worked for](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/d2fb10fa-7fd1-4ef1-b4d3-2619befca589/CHCCS-Helen-Sharma-planned-parenthood.png)** Planned Parenthood facilitating sex ed workshops:

**

![](/media/uploads/2026/01/sharma7.png)

**[View source](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/d2fb10fa-7fd1-4ef1-b4d3-2619befca589/CHCCS-Helen-Sharma-planned-parenthood.png)**

Sharma promotes a Scroggs Library **[google site](https://sites.google.com/chccs.k12.nc.us/mses-remote-learning-resources/library-tech/scroggs-library)** where she links to social justice books through a “Diverse Reading Sources” tab. These **[include](https://www.hopeinabox.org/books)** “Hope in a Box” which links to very sexually explicit LGBT books such as *All Boys Aren’t Blue *and *The Lesbiana’s Guide to Catholic School*.
